user.title: Garage
user.description: Enter your self-hosted Garage server address and the vehicle API token from the web UI's **Vehicle detail → OBD & GPS** page.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Garage
reauth_confirm.description: The API token is no longer valid. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Garage server.

init.title: Choose sensors to forward
init.description: Whenever the value of an entity picked here changes, it's automatically sent to Garage. All fields are optional — leave one blank to skip it.

data.entity_in_vehicle: In-vehicle indicator — binary_sensor/device_tracker, or a numeric sensor like engine load/RPM (treated as in-vehicle when greater than 0)
data.only_when_in_vehicle: Only send while in the vehicle — when on, telemetry is only sent while the "In-vehicle indicator" above is true; otherwise it's skipped. Ignored if you didn't set an in-vehicle indicator.
